I’m excited to introduce MetroVerse v1.0.0! Built-in podcast transcripts, on-device subtitle generation, podcast subtitle translation, smoother lyrics, and the move to InnerTubeX all come together in this release. It’s our most complete music and podcast experience yet, with plenty of improvements to make everyday listening feel better. I’d love for you to try it—update now and enjoy what’s new!

很高兴和大家分享 MetroVerse v1.0.0！这次带来了播客原生字幕、端侧模型识别字幕、播客字幕翻译、更顺手的歌词显示，以及 InnerTubeX 迁移等一大批更新。这是我们迄今最完整、最顺手的「音乐 + 播客」体验，希望你也会喜欢。 强烈推荐现在升级，试试这次的新体验！

## What’s new

- **Podcasts you can read along with:** RSS transcripts become timed subtitles with sentence highlighting, tap-to-seek, timing adjustment, fullscreen reading, and sharing.
- **Subtitles generated on your phone:** Experimental Moonshine English recognition for RSS podcasts, with model download or local import, listening-position priority, and safe resume after interruptions.
- **Bilingual podcast subtitles:** Translate through your configured AI provider, with the original and translation shown together.
- **Smoother lyrics:** Refined highlighting and scrolling, accurate selected-line seeking, and short gaps that hold the current line until the next one starts.
- **Updated YouTube playback:** InnerTubeX handles playback and download resolution, with improved stream fallback, account switching, and retries.
- **Everyday refinements:** Clearer player controls, High audio quality for new preferences, guided API key setup, and separate subtitle, lyric, and translation storage controls. RSS saved episodes stay intact during library synchronization.

## Before you update

- Requires **Android 8.0 or newer and an ARM64 device**.
- On-device recognition is **experimental, English-only, and available for RSS podcasts**. YouTube Music podcasts do not offer it. Download or import the speech model before use.
- Speech recognition runs on your device. Optional AI translation requires your own API configuration and sends subtitle text to your chosen provider.
- Existing audio-quality preferences are preserved.

## 主要更新

- **播客也能边听边看：** RSS 原生字幕融入播放器，支持逐句高亮、点击跳转、时间校准、全屏阅读和字幕分享。
- **手机自己生成字幕：** 实验性 Moonshine 端侧模型为 RSS 播客识别英文字幕，支持模型下载或本地导入，优先识别当前收听位置，并安全恢复中断进度。
- **双语播客字幕：** 通过你配置的 AI 服务翻译，原文与译文一起显示。
- **更顺手的歌词：** 改进高亮与滚动，点击歌词准确跳转；短间隔停留在当前句，等下一句开始再跟随。
- **更新的 YouTube 播放引擎：** 迁移至 InnerTubeX，改善播放、下载、音源回退、账号切换与重试。
- **日常体验打磨：** 调整播放器控制，新用户音质默认「高」，API Key 设置更容易找到，并提供独立的字幕、歌词和翻译存储管理。同步音乐资料库时，RSS 收藏单集也会保留。

## 更新说明

- 需要 **Android 8.0 或更新系统，以及 ARM64 设备**。
- 端侧识别目前是面向 **RSS 播客的实验性英文识别**；YouTube Music 播客不提供此入口。使用前需要下载或导入语音模型。
- 语音识别在本机运行。可选的 AI 翻译需要自行配置 API，字幕文本会发送给你选择的服务。
- 已保存的音质偏好保持不变。
